status: prospective extension after discovering author release and counting name overlap, before examining any age-residual relation; earlier ZTF environment outcomes already inspected
sample: existing ZTF sample matched one-to-one on exact release IAU name to TITAN transient; both host d_DLR<4; finite age/attenuation/metallicity/mass summaries and nonnegative credible widths
models: same-sample nonlinear SALT plus global mass step plus local colour
previous plus TITAN continuous global mass, host attenuation, metallicity
previous plus mass-weighted global host age
same controls plus posterior median of SFH-specific mean progenitor delay
measurement_errors: primary comparison holds TITAN summary predictors fixed; sensitivity adds independent Gaussian marginal-error propagation; full posterior covariance unavailable and no physical identification claim
validation: five existing host-group folds; nested age additions compared to exact same controls/sample; two-sided fixed-design normal power diagnostic at -0.03 mag/Gyr; z>=0.02 and c<0.1 sensitivities
interpretation: TITAN is a prepaper global-host SED posterior summary snapshot, not exact final paper sample, independent local age, full likelihood, or individually observed progenitor ages
